description: This file defines an API client for HTTP communication and an exception class, used for interacting with a backend service in a Flutter application. It includes methods for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests with JSON handling and optional authorization via tokens.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing HTTP error responses, encapsulating status code and message.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A helper class providing HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) with JSON parsing, token-based authorization, and configurable base URL sourced from environment variables.

methods.name: ApiClient.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the API client, determining the base URL from environment or fallback.

methods.name: ApiClient.get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request, returning parsed JSON or null.

methods.name: ApiClient.post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with optional JSON body, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: ApiClient.patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with optional JSON body, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: ApiClient.delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request, returning parsed JSON if any.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs the complete URI with base URL and query parameters.

methods.name: _joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Creates request headers, including authorization if token is provided and content type if needed.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, returning JSON content or throwing an exception on error.
